detail.name: [Ellen] Icy Blade Execution
detail.desc: {AWAKEN_1191#<color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color> DMG Multiplier significantly increases: After launching <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color> and <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, <color=#2BAD00>Basic Attack: Icy Blade will be automatically launched</color> to deal <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in front in a large area</color> and reduces the target's <color=#2BAD00>DEF by 40%</color>, lasting 8s. While launching <color=#FFFFFF>Basic Attack: Icy Blade</color>, Ellen will obtain 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>.}{NOAWAKEN_1191#After activating <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist: Shark Sentinel</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Tail Swipe</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack: Sharknami</color>, an <color=#2BAD00>Icy Blade will be automatically unleashed</color>, dealing <color=#98EFF0>Ice DMG</color> to <color=#2BAD00>enemies in a large area ahead</color> and <color=#2BAD00>reducing the target's DEF by 40</color>, lasting 8s. When the <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> activates, Ellen gains 3<color=#FFFFFF>Flash Freeze Charges</color>; The additional <color=#FFFFFF>Icy Blade</color> does not affect the branch or form of the original skill.}
